text:
maria_finance: Heads up — ACME Health invoice INV-9832 ($28,432) failed twice on autopay. First attempt: card ending 4242 declined by acquirer (FirstPay, decline_code: acquirer_decline). Second attempt: different card ending 5454 declined by issuer/acquirer (EuroPay, decline_code: issuer_declined). Customer says their bank is investigating and won't provide a replacement card right now. @alex_ops @nora_billing can we pick a fallback instead of immediate write-off?
sam_payments: Can you paste the webhook payload and the Stripe decline_reason? Might be acquirer-level block (BIN/MCC) or 3DS/geo issue. Quick check: is this under a reseller / marketplace flow?
maria_finance: Webhook snippet below — stripped PII but includes decline codes: ```{\"id\":\"evt_1Jx...\",\"type\":\"payment_intent.payment_failed\",\"data\":{\"object\":{\"id\":\"pi_1Jx...\",\"amount\":2843200,\"currency\":\"usd\",\"last_payment_error\":{\"type\":\"card_error\",\"code\":\"acquirer_decline\",\"decline_code\":\"do_not_honor\",\"source\":{\"brand\":\"visa\",\"last4\":\"4242\"}}}}}```
alex_ops: FYI I just chatted with the customer. They explicitly said they cannot add a new card until their bank lifts a hold — ETA unknown. They prefer not to do a manual wire but will accept ACH if faster to get them back on autopay. For urgency: this invoice is at threshold where we need manager approval to accept wire (>25k).
nora_billing: Proposed plan: 1) Enable 3 automated retries using our existing retry window (immediate re-attempt, +24h, +72h) 2) Send a secure pay link after first retry fails 3) Offer ACH microdeposit flow (customer to authorize bank account) — note microdeposit takes ~3 business days to verify 4) If all automated retries fail after 5 business days, open a manual-wire option and get approvals. Because amount is $28,432, we need finance manager sign-off for wire. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
sam_payments: I support retry + pay link + ACH. Two flags: a) if acquirer_decline is due to BIN block, further card retries may always fail — try to detect decline families and if acquirer_decline persists, skip card retries and escalate earlier. b) ACH microdeposit works because customer is US-based and bank name matches billing.
payments-bot: [scheduler] Scheduled retry job created for thread 2301234567: attempts=[immediate, +24h, +72h], notify_channel=finance, notify_on_fail=true.
maria_finance: Good. Next: we need a wire template prepped in case customer insists on immediate payment (they said they "prefer not to" but might if urgent). Nora can you draft a wire instructions email with placeholders so we can fast-track manager approval? Also @alex_ops can you confirm whether sales can sign-off on temporarily releasing service if we take manual wire?
nora_billing: Wire template below (DO NOT SEND PLAINTEXT BACS/ACCOUNTS — use secure link): ```Bank: Redwood Bank (placeholder)\nAccount name: Redwood Inference, Inc.\nAccount number: [REDACTED]\nRouting/ABA: [REDACTED]\nSWIFT/BIC: [REDACTED]\nReference: INV-9832 / ACME HEALTH\nNotes: Please email proof of payment to billing@redwood.com```
alex_ops: Sales is willing to approve temporary release of non-critical features after proof-of-payment for this customer. For anything customer-impacting, we need CSM+Manager sign-off. I can fast-track sign-off if wire proof arrives.
sam_payments: Action items: - I will add decline-family detection to this thread and mark retries to skip card attempts if acquirer_decline repeats - Enable ACH microdeposit flow and send secure link to customer (nora please confirm email copy) - If retries + ACH fail after 5 business days, escalate to manual-wire queue and ping @maria_finance for manager approval
maria_finance: Sounds good. Nora — please send the secure pay link + ACH instructions to the customer now and cc alex_ops. Copy the wire template into the secure portal so finance manager can click-to-approve if needed. I'll check back tomorrow for the retry outcomes. Thanks :pray:
